purpose: Character-specific anatomical reference fit (audit only; not a production asset).

items.s1_arm_ring: SHOULDER_RINGS S1 arm portion ("humeral head level")

conventions.world: Blender world metres; +Z up; character faces -Y; anatomical LEFT = +X (F-SIDE-001)
conventions.bone_axes: Bone Y = head->tail; bone Z aligned to anatomical anterior (ISB X).
conventions.marker_axes: Marker X anterior, Y proximal/superior, Z character right (ISB pattern for the marker frame bone).

HARRINGTON_2007.work: Harrington ME et al. Prediction of the hip joint centre in adults, children, and patients with cerebral palsy based on MRI. J Biomech 2007;40:595-602
HARRINGTON_2007.claim: Pelvis-only HJC: AP -0.24PD-9.9, SI -0.30PW-10.9, ML 0.33PW+7.3 mm; PW-only variant AP -0.138PW-10.4, SI -0.305PW-10.9, ML 0.33PW+7.3 (Sangeux 2015 implementation).

SANGEUX_2015.work: Sangeux M. On the implementation of predictive methods to locate the hip joint centres. Gait Posture 2015;42:402-405
SANGEUX_2015.claim: PW-only Harrington variant used when PSIS/pelvic depth is unavailable.

BELL_1990.work: Bell AL, Pedersen DR, Brand RA. A comparison of the accuracy of several hip center location prediction methods. J Biomech 1990;23:617-621
BELL_1990.access: search_snippet (two independent snippets); pyCGM2 implementation conflicts on SI (-0.19PW)
BELL_1990.claim: HJC 19% PW posterior, 30% PW distal, 14% PW medial of ipsilateral ASIS (36% lateral of mid-ASIS).

HARA_2016.work: Hara R et al. Generation of age and sex specific regression equations to locate the hip joint centres. Gait Posture 2016
HARA_2016.claim: AP 11-0.063LL, ML 8+0.086LL, SI -9-0.078LL mm from mid-ASIS (surface; pyCGM2 subtracts marker offsets separately).

DAVIS_1991.work: Davis RB et al. A gait analysis data collection and reduction technique. Hum Mov Sci 1991;10:575-587
DAVIS_1991.claim: C=0.115LL-15.3, theta 0.5 rad, beta 0.314 rad, ASIS-trochanter distance.

PELVIC_TILT.work: Clinical measures of pelvic tilt (IJSPT review) and cited inclinometer studies
PELVIC_TILT.claim: Standing ASIS-PSIS anterior tilt in healthy men 8.6-9.6 deg mean (range 3-18).

KNEE_EPICONDYLE_JL.work: Epicondyle-to-joint-line studies: Brazilian MRI (n=500) 33.39/26.32 mm; Thai MRI (n=140) 27.1/21.7 mm; MRI (n=130) lateral 24.4 mm; cadaver (n=40) 28.95/23.97 mm (medial/lateral)
KNEE_EPICONDYLE_JL.access: search_snippet (PMC12585613, PMC8845375, PMC10250280 and cadaver report)
KNEE_EPICONDYLE_JL.claim: Femoral epicondyles lie 21.7-33.4 mm proximal to the tibiofemoral joint line.

DRILLIS_CONTINI.work: Drillis R, Contini R 1966 segment proportions (as reproduced in Winter, Biomechanics and Motor Control of Human Movement)
DRILLIS_CONTINI.access: search_snippet; labels for 0.530H conflict between secondary sources
DRILLIS_CONTINI.claim: Knee 0.285H, ankle 0.039H, shoulder 0.818H (population proportions; weak cross-check only).

TROTTER_GLESER.work: Trotter M, Gleser GC (1952/1958; Trotter 1970) stature regressions, white males

AHD.work: Evaluation of three-dimensional acromiohumeral distance in the standing position (J Orthop Surg Res 2020; PMC7510276)
AHD.claim: 2D AHD standing 8.8 +/- 1.3 mm in healthy adults.

ACROMION_THICKNESS.work: Acromion morphometry studies (incl. South Indian dry scapulae)

HUMERAL_HEAD_RADIUS.work: Humeral head morphometry (CT 3-D analysis, Acta Orthop; radiologic analysis of normal adults)
HUMERAL_HEAD_RADIUS.claim: Radius of curvature 24.7 mm (bone, coronal) to 28.8 +/- 1.9 mm (males).

malleolus_medial_skin.method: Medial extreme of the last shank section above the leg-foot junction (no modelled malleolar prominence).
malleolus_medial_skin.uncertainty: Bony tip not modelled; level +/-15 mm.

malleolus_lateral_skin.method: Lateral extreme of the same section.
malleolus_lateral_skin.uncertainty: Bony tip not modelled; level +/-15 mm.

surface_junction.method: ISB malleolar-midpoint convention applied at the soft-tissue leg-foot junction (section bounding-box centre).

drillis_contini.method: Height 0.039H; section centre at that height.
drillis_contini.uncertainty: Population proportion; individual variation not modelled

epicondyle_medial_skin.method: Medial extreme of leg section at joint line + pooled epicondyle offset.
epicondyle_medial_skin.uncertainty: Offset study range +/-3 mm; soft-tissue joint line +/-10 mm.

epicondyle_lateral_skin.method: Lateral extreme of the same section.

joint_line_plus_epicondyle_offset.method: Minimum-area knee section (soft-tissue joint line) + pooled epicondyle-to-joint-line offset; ISB midpoint of epicondyles taken as section centre.
joint_line_plus_epicondyle_offset.uncertainty: +/-10 mm vertical, +/-8 mm AP (epicondylar axis assumed at mid-depth)

drillis_contini.method: Height 0.285H; section centre at that height.

asis_skin.method: Superolateral end of the authored inguinal line (generator feature table, verified unchanged in r95), projected to the nearest surface vertex. Anatomical basis: the inguinal ligament attaches to the ASIS.

trochanterion_skin.method: Lateral-most point of the single pelvic section above the crotch (z 0.86-1.00).
trochanterion_skin.uncertainty: Surface extreme; bony greater trochanter not modelled.

harrington_pw_only.method: Harrington PW-only regression (Sangeux 2015 implementation), origin mid-ASIS skin, pelvic frame tilted anteriorly by the standing ASIS-PSIS tilt.
harrington_pw_only.uncertainty: Published MRI validation error ~1-2 cm; ASIS is the skin end of the authored inguinal line.

bell_1990.method: Bell 19% posterior / 30% distal / 36% lateral of mid-ASIS.

hara_2016.method: Hara leg-length regression; LL = ASIS to medial malleolus skin.
hara_2016.uncertainty: Published error ~1 cm in adults; LL depends on estimated malleolus.

davis_1991.method: Davis (CGM) with skin points (no marker radius).
davis_1991.uncertainty: Known to be less accurate than Harrington/Hara.

HJC_selected.method: Mean of Harrington PW-only and Hara (both MRI-validated in adults).
HJC_selected.uncertainty: See method spread and tilt sensitivity

acromion_lateral_skin.method: Exact coronal section through the upper-arm AP centre; first point lateral of x=0.20 where the shoulder-top contour turns steeper than 45 deg.

acromion_depth_chain.method: Acromion skin minus skin+acromion thickness+AHD+head radius (41.8-52.3 mm, mid used) vertically, and ~one head radius medially.

authored_humeral_head_ring.method: Centroid of the generator ring labelled "humeral head level, deltoid wraps the joint" (arm portion), verified present in r95.
authored_humeral_head_ring.uncertainty: Designer intent; ring centroid lies within deltoid soft tissue

deltoid_cap_sphere.method: Least-squares sphere through lateral deltoid-cap vertices.
deltoid_cap_sphere.uncertainty: Fitted radius 81.1 mm; deltoid thickness not uniform

GH_selected.method: Height from the sourced acromion depth chain; mediolateral/anteroposterior from the mean of the three methods.

epicondyle_medial_skin.method: Medial extreme of the minimum-area elbow section between biceps and forearm bellies.

epicondyle_lateral_skin.method: Lateral extreme of the same section.

EJC.method: ISB midpoint of epicondyles approximated by the elbow-waist section centre.

styloid_radial_skin.method: Anterior (thumb-side) extreme of the minimum-area wrist section; palms face medially at rest.

styloid_ulnar_skin.method: Posterior extreme of the same section.

WJC.method: Midpoint between styloids (ISB) approximated by the wrist section centre.
